sources.inspection: Read official description:1844–1846, two-storey Greek Revival house adapted with deep verandahs and restored19th-century appearance.
Visually inspected main hipped roof, four chimney positions, garden front and separate narrow connection to later gallery; excluded gallery from source frame.

scope: Original house only. The two local tea-display interior suggestions were inspected and rejected as exterior references; selected exterior original remains primary. Rear openings are restrained photographic estimates.
